**Top 5 universities in the United Kingdom – The Complete University Guide (2024)**  

| Rank (2024) | University | Year Established* |
|-------------|------------|-------------------|
| 1 | University of Oxford | **c. 1096** (teaching existed from this year; formally chartered 1167) |
| 2 | University of Cambridge | **1209** |
| 3 | Imperial College London | **1907** (formed by the merger of the Royal College of Science, the Royal School of Mines and the City & Guilds College) |
| 4 | London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE) | **1895** |
| 5 | University of St Andrews | **1413** |

\*The “year established” reflects the commonly accepted founding date for each institution as recorded in their official histories and on Wikipedia.  

These are the institutions that occupied the top‑five positions in the 2024 edition of **The Complete University Guide**, one of the leading UK university league‑tables.
